versions.content: AUTOSAR communication shall support the IP protocol stack Type: Valid Description: AUTOSAR communication shall support the IP protocol stack . This includes e. g. IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, ARP, NDP, DHCP, ICMP , ICMPv6 , IPsec Rationale: Ethernet is mostly used to connect to the outside world (non - AUTOSAR bus nodes) . They use these protocols, therefore they need to be available inside AUTOSAR Use Case: Connect to a non - AUTOSAR telematics device, battery charging Dependencies: -- Supporting Material: --
